title: Filtration quotients with genuine completed integral models
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $A=\mathcal O_E$ and $\varpi$ a uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme with $\ell$ invertible. On its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] put $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_X$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and $E_X=B_X[1/\varpi]$. Module sheaves, sheaf tensor products, derived categories and cohomology are as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Write $\mathcal C_X=D^b_c(X,A)$ for the completed integral category including compatible etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], and $Q:\mathcal C_X\to\mathcal R_X=\mathcal C_X[1/\varpi]$ for its raw rationalization [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. A rational module sheaf is constructible when on a finite locally closed stratification it is pro-etale locally finite free [def-constructible-stratification, def-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-module]. Every constructible $E_X$-module sheaf $F$ has a finite filtration $0=F_0\subset F_1\subset\cdots\subset F_m=F$ with quotients $F_k/F_{k-1}\cong v_{k!}(t_k)_*L_k$, where $v_k:V_k\hookrightarrow X$ is a qcqs open immersion, $t_k:S_k\hookrightarrow V_k$ is a reduced closed immersion, and $L_k$ is a lisse $E_{S_k}$-module sheaf. Each $S_k$ is again noetherian finite-dimensional with $\ell$ invertible. There are constructible integral sheaves $N_k$ on $S_k$ and $M_k=v_{k!}(t_k)_*N_k$ on $X$, whose stratum models are $B_S\otimes_A P$ with $P$ finitely presented, with
$$E_{S_k}\otimes_{B_{S_k}}N_k\cong L_k,\quad M_k[0]\in\mathcal C_X,\quad E_X\otimes_{B_X}M_k\cong v_{k!}(t_k)_*L_k.$$
Membership includes completeness and compatible etale-origin witnesses, not just ordinary internal-module constructibility. The last comparison is induced by the sequential localization colimit and the actual exact open/closed module functors [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed], with the ring restrictions of [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficients-immersion-restriction]. Also every lisse $E_X$-sheaf has such a constructible $B_X$ lattice in degree zero [lem-weil-pbc-lisse-e-constructible-integral-lattice]. Finite free continuous $E$ models are identified with the finite constant models for the pulled condensed ring $C(-,E)$ by [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-realizations, def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], only for applying the sheaf filtration [lem-sfb-finite-model-stratum-filtration].
